headline: Apple will be tried in France over planned obsolescence of iPhones
summary: Apple will appear before a Paris court in June 2027, accused of planned obsolescence for preventing repairs of several iPhone models outside its official stores.
why: Apple is a major consumer-electronics company, and French rulings on repair restrictions could affect its service revenue and product design practices in Europe.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: The planned obsolescence case challenges Apple's repair restrictions for iPhones sold in France.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
